title: Seeco diini golo
intro: Aydaadi galitteek iroh caylale mirac kee inkih tan naqoosa le ummattah fanat soolak suge roocih aydaadu yan. Tama num kulli ginô madqak saduh tan qaxmaqaane abak, agat qanxaffek yayyaaqeenimih seeco abe. diini qalek ilaa leeh amol tan muqjiza fan, ta Yallih taama abeyna dabaanitteh addat qagaaqagitak astooti yubleh. asaaku ku taama baxxaaqissam ta assakat le muuci kay naggaarinni seehadayti baxi aydaadih korsi weeloyseh iyya.
clues: Anu elle oobokem yi ummatta qidimih amri edde garayte wakti kinnim kee yi buxah mari yi mano catoonuh leeh addat yoo daffeesen wakti.
Anu yi qaynatih rabah amriseh yan amoyti buxah addal geytimam kee enbe.
Anu diini qale fan kudeeh, tokkel gira elle ubleh an caxak, tokkel xongolo yoh yabte.
Anu too amoytah fan ruubeh suge, inni naqoosa le ummattah amobaxxaaqa esserak.
Anu bad inni caxxat yoogoreeh, kafin gititte fan kurruumak, yi ummatta katayak suge mara yanxuqeh.
Anu inni Rabbi lih morootom bar qalel walaleeh, qibaadah miracsenta tableetitte yoh tomcowwe.
